meta.name: NOMOS AI
meta.description: Watch AI agents implement features while you focus on what matters.

constitution: Every feature must have a complete specification before implementation begins.
All quality gates must pass before any merge to main branch.
Human approval is required for all merges to main branch.
Each feature must be developed in an isolated git worktree.
Each agent session works on exactly one feature.
Insights from each feature must be captured and persisted.
Auto-mode pauses after consecutive failures to prevent runaway errors.
